newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Earthquake jolts Indonesia's Bali, no damage.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake jolts Indonesia's Bali, no damage.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.0 on the Richter scale shook Indonesia's resort island of Bali early on Saturday but there were no reports of damage or casualties, the official Antara news agency reported.

It quoted meteorological officials as saying the epicentre was located under the the Bali straits 38 km (23 miles) west of Denpasar, capital of Bali. Residents of Denpasar said they only felt minor tremors.
